extractor_notes.blockers: PyroGenesis is an industrial plasma technology company (TSX: PYR; NASDAQ: PYR; OTC: PYRGF) focused on plasma torches, plasma atomization (NexGen titanium powder for additive manufacturing/aerospace), biogas upgrading, and waste destruction across three verticals (Energy Transition & Emission Reduction, Commodity Security & Optimization, Waste Remediation). Not a pharmaceutical / biotech / medtech issuer. No clinical pipeline; no PDUFA/BLA/NDA/IND or trial-readout catalysts applicable.
